caseName: Fort Belknap Indian Community v. District Court of the Twelfth Judicial District
caseNameFull: Fort Belknap Indian Community, Fort Belknap Indian Reservation v. District Court of the Twelfth Judicial District of Montana, in and for the County of Blaine

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Mont. Motion of National Congress of American Indians, Inc., for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of respondent James W. Gardipee, real party in interest, for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certiorari denied.
